title: LA City General Fund postings, February 2026 vs February 2025

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a decrease of $12.5m in February 2026 compared to February 2025. This is a 1.3% decrease from the same month last year. Non-Departmental - Human Resources Benefits posted a $13.6m increase in February 2026, while Non-Departmental - General posted a $88.1m increase.

final_text: General Fund postings were $920.1m in February 2026, down 1.3% from $932.6m in February 2025. Year-to-date postings were $6.08bn, up 3.0%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - Human Resources Benefits increased by $13.6m; Non-Departmental - General decreased by $11.3m; Non-Departmental - Liability Claims increased by $9.3m.
